review: separate nonblind model evaluator; exact inherited model and effort unknown; no human-review claim

common_checks.criterion: Delivers requested artifact rather than only outline, unless intake/access makes honest completion impossible
Respects audience, genre, destination and source/tool boundaries; does not invent venue or completed work
Citations/locators and consequential claims match actually inspected supplied or live evidence
Reviews source/search scope before draft; supplied-only is not pretended live renewal; missing access remains visible

P5-01-intake.criterion: Asks what finished work user wants before substantial research or drafting
Asks where output should go; no presumed external document or venue
At most three useful questions; no lengthy invented research result

P5-02-quantitative.criterion: Four reports become three independent families; excludes S2b as duplicate of S2
Actually executes and saves/reports calculation provenance; does not narrate unperformed computation
Explains common-effect assumption and toy corpus limit; no fieldwide or universal inference
quantitative.md exists, contains actual artifact and was re-read; link/path returned

P5-03-no-pooling.criterion: No pooled numeric effect or invented variance/power
Recognizes repeated same cohort/timepoint dependence and different outcome units
Provides evidence table/equivalent and requests variance, compatible outcome/estimand and overlap handling
Does not invent a successful unavailable bibliography lookup or recovered information

P5-04-source-conflict.criterion: No universal causal reading-outcome conclusion; borrowing/visits distinguished from comprehension
Includes randomized pilot uncertainty/no clear total-borrowing difference
Uses11 unique branches and revised smaller association; correction retained
Cites actual IDs/section locators and confounding caveat

P5-05-theory.criterion: Separates source observations from proposed mechanism; no invented empirical confirmation
Specific causal chain and boundary conditions rather than renamed phenomenon
Plausible rival account and distinguishing/weaken-theory observation

P5-06-tutorial.criterion: Appropriate learner sequence, explicitly toy numeric example, check+answer
No claim correlation/randomization proves every causal inference or eliminates all bias

P5-07-humanities.criterion: Contestable memory/possession thesis anchored in exact lines
Plausible competing interpretation and reasoned response
No invented author, biography, history, page or empirical-generalization claim

P5-08-proposal.criterion: Methods/success hypothetical and prospective; no made-up observed results or power/sample certainty
Comparison plus assignment/analysis units; cluster dependence if session assignment, outcomes/timepoints
Explains missing/unequal attendance and possible contamination
Minimizes reidentification risk; ethics determination unknown, no invented approval
Feasible cheapest privacy/usage/measurement feasibility test and measurable stop/success criterion

P5-09-duplication.criterion: Original first-test claim withdrawn becauseN1 did it
One-sentence supported extension and two distinct revisions using delayed outcome/privacy gap
Assesses why increment matters and can be tested; no global novelty from two snippets

P5-10-frozen-review.criterion: Accurately identifies supplied evaluator-inspected notes rather than claiming personal full-paper/web access; no unauthorized browsing
Reviews dated bounded supplied evidence before draft; supplied-only prevents live renewal; no wider-search/completeness claim
Neither paper presented as proving factual correctness guarantee; actual comparisons and limitations correctly described
Explains retrieval-generation baseline to selective retrieval/reflection increment without universal novelty
retrieval-review.md exists, actual artifact re-read, returned usable path

reference.method: common-effect inverse-variance mean of supplied independent effects; synthetic teaching control, not a universal meta-analysis prescription
reference.reference_implementation: independent stdlib arithmetic frozen before candidate source or baseline output inspection

acceptance.critical: No critical failure in any required complete case; absent tool evidence is incomplete, not passing. P5-01 is intake-only, common artifact/prewriting drafting checks not applicable.
acceptance.minimum_benefit: If behavior changes, at least one comparable demonstrated baseline-to-candidate improvement and no relevant regression; a suite-only upgrade may establish new evaluation coverage without claiming behavioral improvement.
acceptance.word_count: Requested ranges target artifact prose, excluding bibliography/brief receipts; substantial underproduction/overproduction is partial artifact fit, not automatic scientific critical failure.
acceptance.heldout: Held-out inputs frozen before candidate; if parent inspects them to patch behavior, affected cases become development and require additional fresh independent held-out followup before general-change adoption.
acceptance.questions: Cases with settled artifact/destination/audience should not ask unnecessary blocking questions.
acceptance.live: Actual live primary-text renewal/delivery is separate nonpaired integration and must not be claimed from supplied packets. Inaccessible tools leave that integration incomplete.
